provenance: Rows of mv_financial_facts on xbrl_db, read-only, 2026-11-07: undimensioned, fiscal_period FY, canonical filing, the family's period type and duration_kind annual or instant, concepts matching the case's list. value is the stored effective value; decimals is the fact's decimals (null when INF), as docs/specs/rounded-duplicates.md defines it; period_end is stored end-exclusive (SEC end + 1 day). presented: the concept is a child in the filing's mv_presentation_network under a role whose definition contains ' - Statement - ' and not 'Parenthetical'. companyfacts: the cached SEC companyfacts file for the filer agrees on accession, end - 1 day, start and value (match), lacks the fact (absent), carries another value (mismatch:<SEC>), is not cached (not_cached), or the concept is a filer extension, which companyfacts omits (extension).
